{{Attr|Bloated}} (Variable) }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Frost Undead''' is a fast enemy that appears in the [[Frost Mode|Frost]] mode. Like most of that mode's enemies, it first appeared in the [[Operation I.C.E Event]]. It has a high amount of health, low [[Defense]] and a fast speed. ==Logbook Description== "''Unknown to the Frost Realm, these monstrosities are handcrafted by Necromancers to be the most fearsome fighters. Unnatural to their world, the Frost Undead prowl like ferocious, feral beings. Elongated claws grip the earth while large jaws lock onto their victims. On the battlefield, the Frost Undead are created by the Frost Necromancer.''" ==Appearance== The '''Frost Undead''' is a creature with blue and grey skin. It has a thin body with claw like hands, multiple teeth on its head and horns on its head. On its shoulders, it has multiple blue spikes coming out of it, while on its torso there are blue ribs. It has grey chains wrapped around its arms. ==Strategy== *Towers with good DPS like the [[Accelerator]], [[Turret]], [[Ranger]] or [[Pursuit]] are recommended against this. *Due to its fast speed, stalling towers like the [[Electroshocker]], [[Freezer]] or [[Toxic Gunner]] can be used to slow it down. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Converted Variants}} DefHacker1FrostUndead.png|Green variant, current version (11 June 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFrostUndead.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Pulse Trooper Trailer -
